data.title: The Art of Lisp and Writing (2003)
data.author: Bogdanp
data.article_summary: 文章探讨了Lisp编程与写作艺术的相似性，强调编程如同艺术创作，是一种自我表达和创造性活动，而非单纯的工程技术。文章引用达尔文的观点，指出无知往往滋生自信，而知识则带来谦逊。作者认为编程如同写作，是一种艺术形式，程序员通过与表达媒介的互动创造出美妙且有机的作品。文章还讨论了艺术与科学、工程的关系，指出艺术家的创作不仅反映可能性，还推动科技发展，如《浮士德》中的幻想促成了现代科技的实现。文章最后强调，工程知识常先于科学理论，并通过历史实例说明工程实践与科学理论的演变关系。总的来说，编程和工程都是艺术与科学的结合，是一种追求真理的连续体。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：编程语言的美学、实用性以及编程活动的性质

不同观点：
• rednafi：认为Python早期具有独特的美感，但现在由于AI工具的普及，编程不再显得那么深奥和独特。他更倾向于使用Go语言，因为Go语言稳定、向后兼容，并且没有过多的外部依赖管理工具。他对Python的类型系统和依赖管理工具持批评态度。
• chris_armstrong：强调编程作为一种社会活动，应该关注集体知识的建立和共享，而不是仅仅作为个人探索和发现的工具。他认为将编程视为一种社会活动会得出与原文作者相反的结论。
• pjmlp：通过引用Gabriel的其他作品，如Cadillac项目和XEmacs，指出早期C++环境和编辑器的发展历史，强调技术发展的连续性和基础设施的重要性。
• noelwelsh：赞赏Richard Gabriel的写作，特别是他的文章《The Structure of a Programming Language Revolution》，认为其见解深刻且富有美感。
• b0a04gl：认为Lisp的力量在于其开放性和可重塑性，现代语言则更多地将定制作为高级功能而不是基础功能。Lisp更像是一种可写的基质，而不是一种固定的语言。
• mightyham：批评原文作者对Lisp和写作之间关系的描述，认为Lisp更像是一种编程媒介而不是语言，其自我表达的特点使其与人类语言有根本区别。
• azeirah：赞赏Lisp的独特体验，但也承认 pragmatists 在软件开发中更关注实际交付和盈利，而非艺术性。他认为艺术和工艺结合的编程是一个小众领域，但在爱好者中仍然 thriving。
• holri：认为Python继承了Lisp的许多艺术特质，因此Lisp的艺术动态方法在Python的流行中得到了体现。
• quantadev：认为LLMs的发展使得通过自然语言描述生成代码成为可能，未来可能只需要一种或两种编程语言。他提到no-code或low-code系统，并认为Lisp的简洁语法使其成为理想的选择。
• bowsamic：认为像Lisp和Smalltalk这样的语言所带来的创造性自由被夸大了。他指出实际的障碍在于设备制造商对创作的控制，如iPhone的开发限制，这比语言本身的特性更重要。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是编程语言的艺术性和实用性之间的平衡，以及现代技术发展对编程活动的影响。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是Lisp的历史地位和其在现代编程中的继承与发展。
• 对编程语言未来的展望，特别是LLMs和no-code/low-code系统的发展方向，也是讨论的一个重要方面。

The Art of Lisp & Writing
Ignorance more frequently begets confidence than does knowledge.
–Charles Darwin
Lisp is the language of loveliness. With it a great programmer can make a beautiful, operating thing, a thing organically created and formed through the interaction of a programmer/artist and a medium of expression that happens to execute on a computer.
Taught that programming—or the worse "developing software"—is like a routine engineering activity, many find difficulty seeing writing as a model or even a metaphor for programming. Writing is creative, it is self-expression, it is art, which is to say it isn't a science and unlike science and engineering, it isn't a serious activity. Judgments like this, though, are easiest made by people who don't seriously engage in making both science and art. Art, engineering, and science are—in that order—part of a continuum of finding truth in the world and about ourselves.
Artists make things and have always done so, gathering knowledge. There is sometimes no other purpose for what artists make than the need to embody an artistic statement in some form—perhaps in an artifact or perhaps on paper. When an artist makes something, he or she is drawing on two parts (at least) of the world at the same time: the part that is driving the construction which could be thought of as being within the artist in a sense, and the part that is in the world providing the substances that combine under physical laws to become the artistic artifact. The least bit of artistic knowledge-making is that the artist is, in making the thing, making a map of what is possible and how the physical world relates to the metaphorical, imaginative, and interior worlds of people. And the other extreme is that in trying to make something perhaps grand, the artist is stretching what people know about the world. Even today there is debate about how some artistic structures were made by ancient artists. Artists discover the properties of the world.
Artists who create by writing or producing other representations of what the world is or could be are also laying out a map for how the world could become, and in cases where artists need technological explanations in their stories and myths, scientists and engineers in many cases explore how to build what they were delighted to learn about as children or adults from the dream-makers. For example, in 1587 someone published a set of tall tales about a possibly historical man known as "Faustus" in a book that came to be known as
German Faustbuch
or
Historia von D. Johan Faustus
. The Faustbuch was translated and changed by a man known only as "P. F." in 1592 into the English as
The History of the Damnable Life and Deserved Death of Doctor John Faustus
. In this book Dr. John Faustus rides a wagon pulled by dragons to the sun. And as time went on, engineers and scientists worked on and devised flying machines, as commonplace today as were sailing ships in the 16
th
century. Is it a coincidence that cellphones look suspiciously like Star Trek communicators? We can see an early fascination with traveling beneath the sea in the story of Jonah and in the legend of Atlantis. Greeks and Romans wrote about diving bells, and so did medieval writers.
As people need or want to do things with materials and the world, people with special skill take the fore and devise or discover how to manipulate the physical world to make those things. To avoid future mistakes, these makers write down rules of thumb, patterns of creation and making, and safety factors as a practical matter. Today we call them engineers. When we think of engineering today we think of carefully planned scientific engineering such as building bridges, where it is a fairly linear though costly and complicated process to go from the planning stage to a completed bridge. We forget the centuries of tinkering with bridge design in prehistoric and ancient times when bridges were gingerly tested as designers searched for principles. Even still, on November 7, 1940, at 11:00AM, the Tacoma Narrows Bridge collapsed from wind-caused vibrations after being open to the public for a few months, showing that even sophisticated engineering techniques—one could even call them contemporary engineering techniques—can fail.
†
Nevertheless, engineering knowledge has usually preceded scientific knowledge and often has remained constant while scientific theories about the engineering materials came and went. "Engineers" were able to create sophisticated fires for cooking and metal working using chimneys and other forms of forced oxygen for centuries while scientists flailed from theory to theory. For example, while advanced fire-based engineering was going on in the 6
th
century BC in Greece, Anaximenes's theory was that the source or nature of the cosmos was
aer
(air).
Aer
was constantly in motion. When
aer

aither

data.title: CI/CD Observability with OpenTelemetry Step by Step Guide
data.author: ankit01-oss
data.article_summary:
本文介绍了如何使用OpenTelemetry（OTel）实现对CI/CD管道（特别是GitHub Actions）的可观察性。OpenTelemetry是一个开源的可观察性框架，能够以供应商无关的方式收集 traces、metrics 和 logs。通过配置 OTel，可以捕捉 CI/CD 管道的遥测数据，提供端到端的可见性、性能优化、错误检测与调试以及依赖分析等优势。

文中详细说明了如何使用 OTel 的 GitHub Receiver 来接收 GitHub 工作流事件并将其转化为 trace 数据，以及如何通过 API 抓取指标。具体步骤包括在 GitHub 配置 webhook、设置访问令牌以及安装和配置 OTel Collector。最终，通过 OTel 可以统一监控管道运行情况，提升调试效率。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕CI/CD工具、OpenTelemetry（OTel）的应用及相关技术选择的讨论

不同观点：
• [127dot1] 认为文章标题有误导性，文章内容仅限于GitHub的CI/CD，而不是泛指CI/CD，因此对大多数CI/CD场景没有帮助。
• [hrpnk] 对OTel在长时间运行的批处理/异步进程中的使用效果提出疑问，尤其是构建时间较长的单体应用的监控和追踪。
• [remram] 指出OTel的文件支持不足，特别是在CI作业中收集数据并进行分析时，缺乏简便的方法来导出和加载文件用于后续分析。
• [totetsu] 分享了他们的实际经验，尝试通过GitHub Actions和API调用收集详细信息，并将其发送到如Jaeger或Grafana等工具进行性能分析。他们认为API比直接从运行主机上查看日志文件更详细。
• [reactordev] 基于大规模可观察性的经验，指出SigNoz和Prometheus等工具的局限性，认为AWS的CloudWatch在纯云环境中表现更好，因为它们能获取更多底层基础设施的数据。但如果拥有自建基础设施，SigNoz会是更好的选择。同时强调一旦选择OTel，后续更换将非常困难。

CI/CD Observability with OpenTelemetry - A Step by Step Guide
Author:
Elizabeth Mathew
In the fast-paced world of CI/CD, understanding the performance and behaviour of your pipelines is crucial. GitHub Actions has become a popular choice for automating builds and deployments, but anyone who's debugged a flaky workflow or long-running job knows how challenging it can be to get visibility into what's happening under the hood. We usually rely on build logs, timing data, or guesswork when something goes wrong.
Wouldn't it be nice to trace a pipeline run step-by-step, or have metrics on how your workflows are performing over time?
This is where OpenTelemetry comes into play.
OpenTelemetry [OTel]
is an open-source observability framework that enables collecting traces, metrics, and logs in a standard, vendor-agnostic way. With a bit of configuration, OTel can capture telemetry from even our CI/CD pipelines. In this guide, we'll walk through setting up OpenTelemetry for GitHub Actions [covering both tracing and metrics], with practical examples and configuration snippets.
Why Observe CI/CD Pipelines with OpenTelemetry [OTel]?
Just as we use traces and metrics to understand microservices and applications, we can apply the same to CI/CD pipelines. Instrumenting GitHub Actions with OpenTelemetry yields several benefits:
End-to-end visibility:
You can trace the entire lifecycle of a workflow run, from trigger to completion. Each job and step can be visualised, showing how they execute and interact.
Performance optimisation:
By measuring the duration of each job and step, you can identify bottlenecks or slow steps in your pipeline.
For example, a long testing phase or a slow dependency installation.
Error detection and debugging:
Traces can pinpoint exactly where a workflow failed or took an unexpected path, making it easier to debug broken pipelines. Instead of combing through logs, you'll see which step or action resulted in an error.
Dependency analysis:
In complex workflows with multiple jobs [possibly with dependencies or concurrent runs], tracing helps you understand how different jobs and steps relate to each other within the workflow.
Traditionally, engineering teams have monitored CI pipelines using ad-hoc methods, maybe exporting build logs to an ELK stack, timing data to Prometheus, or using CI-specific analytics. Those approaches often cover only metrics [like durations, success/failure counts] or logs. OpenTelemetry provides a unified approach, it can capture
traces
[for structure and timing] and
metrics
[for quantitative monitoring] in one system.
Every pipeline run can become a trace, and important KPIs can be emitted as metrics using OTel. Next, we'll see how to set this up with GitHub Actions.
How OpenTelemetry Captures GitHub Actions Data
To make GitHub Actions observable with OTel, we leverage a component of the OTel Collector known as the
GitHub Receiver
. This receiver can do some very cool things like,
Ingest GitHub workflow events as traces:
GitHub can send events [via webhooks] whenever workflows run or jobs execute. The GitHub Receiver accepts these events and converts them into trace data.
Scrape GitHub metrics via the API:
The same receiver can use GitHub's APIs [GraphQL and REST] to scrape repository and workflow-related metrics. This includes information like
repository size, star count, open pull requests, issue counts, contributor statistics
, and more.
📝
Note
We can set intervals at which scraping should take place when configuring the receiver as shown below:
github
:
initial_delay
:
1s
collection_interval
:
60s
In the sections below, we'll go through the steps to configure the OpenTelemetry Collector with the GitHub receiver for both traces and metrics.
Setting Up the OpenTelemetry Collector for GitHub Actions Observability
Okay. Let's dive into the setup.
Step 0: Updating Your GitHub Config
On the GitHub side of things, you'll need to set up a webhook on your repository [or organization] that sends
workflow_run
and
workflow_job
events to your Collector endpoint. In GitHub's settings, add a new webhook and select at least these two event types, with the content type set to
application/json
.
We will configure the Collector to listen for these events on a specific URL. You'll also need a secret token for the webhook [a random string] to secure it; the Collector will use the same secret to validate incoming events.
For metrics, if you want to scrape data from the GitHub API, you'll need an access token with permissions to read repo and workflow data. You can read this
guide
to understand how to get your personal access token.
Configure your GitHub webhook
With that in place, let's set up the Collector step by step.
Step 1: Install/ Update the OTel Collector
If you haven't already, install the OpenTelemetry Collector [we'll use the
otelcol-contrib
distribution because the GitHub receiver is part of the contrib components

data.article_summary: 本文讨论了无限方格电阻网络中两个节点间电阻的计算问题。常见方法是叠加两个“单极”解，一个代表1安培电流注入某节点并向外无限流动，另一个代表1安培电流从某节点抽取并从无限流入。对于相邻节点，解较为明确，但对于任意节点，需对“无限远处”的电压和电流施加限制才能得到唯一解。通过设定对角线参数，可以构造整个无限网格，发现对角线节点间电阻为零，暗示这些节点间无电阻，类似于超导体。然而，这种解法在远离对角线处电压和电流会趋向无穷大。最终，文章指出只要满足欧姆定律，可以有无穷多种解，因为原问题未限制无限远处的行为。

不同观点：
• ofrzeta：认为事件中SRE团队的快速反应是积极的一面，但也指出在恢复过程中，由于服务控制任务重启，在大型区域（如us-central-1）产生了对底层基础设施（如Spanner表）的过度负载。他提到这种情况经常发生，建议在特殊情况下可以临时禁用配额或限制恢复操作，以避免再次失败。

• cddotdotslash：对多区域机制在实际故障中的表现提出质疑，认为尽管多区域通常被认为是提高弹性和可用性的方法，但在此次事件中，大型云供应商的区域间似乎存在紧密的相互依赖，导致无法有效隔离故障。

• rezonant：指出官方状态页的状态更新不如一些客户（如HN评论中提到的）提供的信息全面，认为应该直接引用官方状态页作为事件报告的来源。

• rvnx：对官方支持的不及时和不透明表示不满，认为作为客户，HN社区比官方支持更早知道问题所在，这是不合理的。

• junon：用“空指针再次袭击”来简短评论，暗示问题的根源可能是由于代码中的低级错误（如空指针引用）导致的。

• secondcoming：对新代码在未被标记保护的情况下默认启用表示困惑，认为如果使用了标记保护，问题应在准备阶段就被发现和解决。

补充讨论：
• 事件中的技术细节，如服务控制任务重启导致的负载问题、多区域基础设施的相互依赖性，以及代码中可能的错误，都是讨论的焦点。
• 对官方支持和信息透明度的批评，以及对多区域机制在实际应用中效果的质疑，显示了客户对云服务提供商在故障处理和信息发布方面的更高期望。
• 不同评论者对事件原因和应对方案的分析，提供了多角度的见解，有助于更全面地理解事件的全貌。

data.title: Spatializing 6k years of global urbanization from 3700 BC to AD 2000
data.author: talonx
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了首个涵盖公元前3700年至公元2000年全球城市住区位置和人口数据的时空明确数据集。通过数字化、转录和地理编码历史、考古和人口普查数据，研究团队整理并统一了先前以表格形式发布的城市人口数据。该数据集为每个地理编码位置创建了可靠性排名，以评估数据点的地理不确定性。该研究填补了全球范围内长期历史城市化趋势数据的空白，有助于理解当代和历史上的城市化模式。文章还讨论了城市分布与农业区域的关系，验证城市在肥沃农业区发展更快的假设。该数据集为研究城市化对环境的影响提供了基础。

44280966.article_content:
Spatializing 6,000 years of global urbanization from 3700 BC to AD 2000
Download PDF
Download PDF
Subjects
Anthropology
Environmental sciences
Environmental social sciences
Geography
Abstract
How were cities distributed globally in the past? How many people lived in these cities? How did cities influence their local and regional environments? In order to understand the current era of urbanization, we must understand long-term historical urbanization trends and patterns. However, to date there is no comprehensive record of spatially explicit, historic, city-level population data at the global scale. Here, we developed the first spatially explicit dataset of urban settlements from 3700 BC to AD 2000, by digitizing, transcribing, and geocoding historical, archaeological, and census-based urban population data previously published in tabular form by Chandler and Modelski. The dataset creation process also required data cleaning and harmonization procedures to make the data internally consistent. Additionally, we created a reliability ranking for each geocoded location to assess the geographic uncertainty of each data point. The dataset provides the first spatially explicit archive of the location and size of urban populations over the last 6,000 years and can contribute to an improved understanding of contemporary and historical urbanization trends.

Background & Summary
Whether it is for timely response to catastrophes, the delivery of disaster relief, assessing human impacts on the environment, or estimating populations vulnerable to hazards, it is essential to know where people and cities are geographically distributed. Additionally, the ability to geolocate the size and location of human populations
over time
helps us understand the evolving characteristics of the human species, especially human interactions with the environment. Now that humans are predominantly an urban species, new questions arise as to how urban populations have changed over time. Where were cities of the past? What were the sizes of these urban populations and how were large and small cities geographically distributed? Many scholars question the sustainability of contemporary urbanization, arguing that the rates and scales of urbanization today present a new relationship between urbanization and the biosphere. However, in order to contextualize the current period of the urban demographic process and understand its potential future trajectories, we need data on long-term historical urbanization trends and patterns.
Currently, the only spatially explicit data on urban population with global coverage is the
United Nations World Urbanization Prospects
1
. It is considered the most authoritative source of global urban population data and provides information on urban populations for major urban agglomerations around the world. The available data include latitude and longitude values for places with populations of 300,000 or more. However, these data are only available starting in 1950. Here, we provide the first spatially explicit, digital database of 6,000 years of urban settlements worldwide.
We developed the dataset using two principal sources:
Four Thousand Years of Urban Growth: A Historical Census
2
, by historian Tertius Chandler and
World Cities: -3,000 to 2,000
3
, by political scientist George Modelski. It is important to note that the dataset presented here is a spatial rendering of both Chandler’s and Modelski’s original datasets. We have not edited the population estimates themselves. We have harmonized the datasets and spatialized the data by providing latitude and longitude values for each settlement location. We have not extrapolated those city point locations to urban extents or city area estimates.
Our primary and original motivation for developing this dataset was to empirically test the oft-cited hypothesis that cities have historically developed in fertile agricultural areas. While the earliest record of cities traces their location to the Sumer region of Mesopotamia, or modern day Kuwait and Iraq, the hypothesis that cities in or near agricultural areas grow faster than cities located elsewhere has not been systematically test

data.title: Datalog in Rust
data.author: brson
data.article_summary: 这篇文章是Frank McSherry的博客，标题为《Public Notifications》。文章讨论了在使用软件或平台时，公共通知系统的设计和实现问题。作者强调了通知系统的重要性，尤其是在多人协作或共享资源的场景下。文中提到当前许多系统在这方面存在不足，容易导致用户错过重要更新或信息。Frank建议改进通知系统的设计，使其更具可定制性和针对性，以提高用户体验和信息传递效率。文章还涉及一些技术细节和潜在的解决方案。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Datalog技术的应用、实现及其优缺点

不同观点：
• Leynos认为使用Differential Datalog和Rust开发实时策略游戏是一种接触新想法并进行深度技术探索的借口，尽管过程中会遇到很多繁琐的问题。
• burakemir分享了将mangle datalog移植到Rust上的进展，指出Rust版本通过内存映射处理磁盘数据，而Go版本则是内存处理。他还提到了一些使用proc-macro的Datalog实现（如ascent、crepe），这些实现不支持在运行时处理查询。
• banana_feather对作者在Datalog教程中使用binary join的方法提出了批评，认为generic join方法更易于泛化和理解，并提供了一个相关算法的链接。
• maweki对Datalog爱好者的坚持表示赞赏，尽管Datalog复兴热潮有所减退。他分享了自己在数据质量管道中使用Datalog的经验，认为Datalog在查找和识别数据质量问题方面比SQL更有用。
• tulio_ribeiro称赞了作者技术博客的写作风格，认为其既深入技术细节又富有趣味性，将技术优化过程比作侦探故事。
• rnikander提到一些Clojure爱好者认为Datalog优于SQL，并对这种观点背后的原因表示好奇。
• rienbdj对VMWare是否已经放弃Differential Datalog表示疑问。
• 29athrowaway推荐使用cozodb，这是一个用Rust编写并支持Datalog查询语法的项目。

补充讨论：
• Datalog在不同语言和环境下的实现差异，如Rust和Go版本的实现对比。
• 对Datalog教学方法的讨论，特别是对binary join和generic join的优劣比较。
• Datalog社区的现状及其应用趋势，包括对Datalog复兴热潮减退的观察。
• 对具体技术博客写作风格的赞赏，强调技术内容的可读性和趣味性。
• 对Datalog和SQL之间优劣的讨论，反映了不同技术背景的人对这两种技术的看法。

data.title: Ruby on Rails Audit Complete
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了开源技术改进基金（OSTIF）对Ruby on Rails框架的安全审计结果。审计由X41 D-Sec主导，GitLab和主权技术机构（Sovereign Tech Agency）协助，历时四个月，涉及五个不同的利益相关者。审计过程包括创建威胁模型和手动代码审查，发现了一个高危漏洞和六个低危漏洞，并提出了六项安全加固建议。报告肯定了Rails社区在提升安全方面的努力，同时指出了项目可以改进的领域。OSTIF也对参与此次审计的团队和个人表示感谢，并庆祝其成立十周年。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Ruby on Rails 的生产力、安全性及其与其他框架的比较

不同观点：
• ukprogrammer 认为 Rails 在 B2B 'CRUD' 软件中的生产力无可匹敌，并对新创公司不广泛使用 Rails 感到惊讶。
• ksec 关注 Rails 的安全问题，提到某些漏洞可能未在 8.0.2 版本中修复，并期待 Rails 8.1 的发布。
• ostif-derek 回应社区反馈，提到由于预算限制，一些计划中的安全工作（如对 Spring/Elixir/Django/Phoenix 的支持）未能实现，但会继续努力争取更多资金。
• hhthrowaway1230 对 Rails 的大型代码库中发现的漏洞数量之少表示惊讶，但对结果表示满意。
• Levitating 对使用 "Rails application server" 这一术语提出异议，认为应该使用 "Rack application servers" 以更准确地描述 Rack 在 Ruby CGI 实现中的角色。

• jensenbox 寻找可以资助 Django 安全审计的途径，表示愿意贡献资金。
• mediumsmart 分享自己使用 Rails 默认设置的子集，并表示没有失望。
• sgt 希望能有对 Django 的安全审计。
• RKFADU_UOFCCLEL 用讽刺的语气提到通过某些手段（如系统命令注入）可能导致的安全漏洞，对发现的问题表示感谢。
• dzonga 强调选择 Rails 或其他主流 web 框架已经规避了许多行业内的安全漏洞，并认为 JS 生态中没有与 Rails 对等的框架，如 next.js 不算真正的 web 框架。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及多个框架的比较，如 Django、Phoenix 和 Laravel，以及对 next.js 是否为 web 框架的争论。
• 安全审计的资金和社区支持是讨论中一个重要的限制因素，特别是对于非 Rails 框架如 Django 的审计需求。
• 术语使用的准确性（如 "Rails application server" 与 "Rack application servers"）也在讨论中被提及，显示出技术社区对细节的关注。

The
Open Source Technology Improvement Fund
is proud to share the results of our security audit of
Ruby on Rails
. Ruby on Rails (or “Rails”) is an open source full stack web-application framework. Thanks to the help of
X41 D-Sec
,
GitLab
, and the
Sovereign Tech Agency
, Rails can provide more secure versions of the tools needed for users to create database-backed web applications following the Model-View-Controller pattern.
Audit Process
:
The audit work for this engagement took place over December of 2024 to March of 2025, spanning 4 months and involving 5 different stakeholders. The auditing and report were completed by the team at X41 D-Sec, with support provided by Gitlab through the participation of the GitLab Security Research Team. First, the auditors created a threat model for the project which outlined the function, deployment scenarios, entry points, trust boundaries, threats, and Ruby on Rails specific vulnerabilities. After they finished their initial investigation of the project via threat modelling, auditors performed manual auditing on the codebase assisted by tooling and fuzzers.
Audit Results
:
7 Findings with Security Impact
1 High
6 Low
6 Hardening Recommendations
Custom Threat Modelling
The report notes that the security of Ruby on Rails has matured over in the past few years. That is a great sign of a project with healthy and productive community involvement.  It further details possible areas of improvement for the project’s security posture as well as the areas not covered by this work due to the size of the project and time constraints of the engagement.
Thank you
to the individuals and groups that made this engagement possible:
Rails maintainers and community
X41 D-Sec, especially: Eric Sesterhenn, Joern Schneeweisz, J.M., Markus Vervier, Robert Femmer, and Antonela Conti
GitLab, especially Joern Schneeweisz

data.title: Text-to-LoRA: Hypernetwork that generates task-specific LLM adapters (LoRAs)
data.author: dvrp
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了Text-to-LoRA（T2L）项目，这是一种通过文本任务描述适应大型语言模型（LLM）的超网络方法。项目提供了安装指南、演示步骤以及如何生成和评估LoRA模型的详细说明。用户需安装`uv`工具并下载相关检查点以运行演示。演示包括通过命令行界面生成LoRA和使用Web UI展示Mistral-7B模型的效果。项目还提供了训练LoRA的脚本和步骤，包括同步训练和重建训练。值得注意的是，即使使用随机描述，SFT训练的T2L仍能生成合理的LoRA模型，且对齐描述的LoRA表现更好。训练过程可能需要较长时间，具体取决于硬件配置。

LoRA generation from CLI
This script allows us to generate a LoRA based on a task description. Running for the first time would take longer as the base model will be downloaded and cached.
#
uv run generate_lora.py {T2l_DIRECTORY} {TASK_DESCRIPTION}
#
e.g.,
uv run python scripts/generate_lora.py \
trained_t2l/llama_8b_t2l \

"
This task challenges your problem-solving abilities through mathematical reasoning. You must carefully read each scenario and systematically work through the data to compute the final outcome.
"

uv run python scripts/run_eval.py --model-dir {base_model_dir} \
#

#

uv run python scripts/run_eval.py \

Trade and geopolitics
"Make in India" relies on "Made in China"
Akhil Ramesh
Akhil Ramesh
Share
Published 13 May 2025
13-05-2025
The overlap between trade and national security has become more acute over the last decade, leading to a resurgence in industrial policies globally. In India, New Delhi is increasingly realizing that a pivot towards manufacturing requires increased economic linkages with nations that have mastered it. While the country negotiates closer trade ties with the US, it is simultaneously nurturing a robust and growing economic relationship with China.
White Paper
In 2014, Modi launched the "Make in India" initiative with the ambitious aim to transform India into a global manufacturing hub. The government envisioned that targeted industrial policies, along with streamlined regulations and reduced red tape, would create a conducive environment for investment. New Delhi set the goal of raising manufacturing’s share in India’s GDP from 15% in 2014 to 25% by 2025. In his second term, Modi’s administration identified 14 key sectors and introduced sector-specific industrial policies known as the Production Linked Incentive scheme (PLI). PLI had a two-pronged, zealous agenda: increase the share of manufacturing in India’s GDP, and reduce reliance on China in key sectors.
Fast forward to a decade later, while the value of electronics exports has increased, neither the share of manufacturing in India’s GDP has increased nor has India wholly reduced its dependence on China in key sectors. The dependence on China has only shifted from downstream goods to upstream goods. In fact, as of 2025, manufacturing’s share of India’s GDP has dropped to under 14% — lower than in 2014 when the Make in India initiative was formally announced.
Download

by Akhil Ramesh:
Download Now
With an outlay of 1.9 trillion Indian rupees (US$26 billion), the PLI scheme produced mixed results. In semiconductors and defense, manufacturing plants have sprung up in Gujarat in the west of India and Assam in the east through partnerships with American and Taiwanese companies. The telecommunications sector has achieved a 60% import substitution in critical components. In less than two years from 2023, imports of PV cells and modules from China dropped to 56% for PV cells and 66% for modules from more than 90% as a share of India’s PV imports. Unimaginable a decade ago, Apple is now producing 20% of its iPhones in India – one of the most talked-about success stories out of the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyaan, or Self-Reliant India campaign.
At the same time, India’s imports of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) from China dropped only marginally from 75% to 72% of total API imports. In electric vehicle (EV) battery manufacturing, the progress of import substitution has been slow, and the required technologies are still mostly licensed from Chinese companies. Sectors such as specialty steel, textiles, and auto parts and components also failed to achieve manufacturing targets set by the government.
Most of the success stories outlined above have one thing in common – they are successes in the downstream of a value chain. India’s reliance on inputs from China has not been reduced. It has taken a different form.
Take smartphones as an example. Apple’s supply chain in China is a comprehensive collaboration between universities, research institutions, and industry. From circuit boards to displays, Apple has built up an entire value chain in China with the help of the Chinese government over the course of two decades. Apple has managed to recreate only a small part of this complex value chain in India, where it is largely limited to the downstream component. Furthermore, while India fostered software development training for its youth over the course of the last two decades, it has not cultivated a workforce ready for manufacturing, including assembly of components. This has created a dependency on Chinese expertise.
The PLI scheme is up for possible termination as its intended goals have not been met. But New Delhi has decided to continue its industrial policy with one drastic change — it is opening itself up even more to Chinese investment. In late March 2025, New Delhi accelerated talks with global players in the electronics supply chain, primarily Chinese suppliers, to establish joint ventures (JVs) and strategic partnerships. Dixon, one of India’s contract manufacturing successes, already sealed a JV with China’s HKC Co. LTD to produce semiconductor display modules.
Concerns over Beijing’s belligerence in the Indo-Pacific catalyzed expanded cooperation between Washington and New Delhi, especially after deadly clashes in the China-India border in 2017 and 2020, respectively. 主要讨论点：用户对TimeGuessr及其类似游戏的体验与评价

不同观点：
• [正面评价] 
  - **mmahemoff**: 认为游戏的时间元素增加了新的维度，很有趣。
  - **Arech**: 非常喜欢游戏的三维性质和图片的精心选择，认为比GeoGuessr更有趣。
  - **elwell**: 对游戏体验感到惊喜，并获得了高分。

• [功能与使用困惑]
  - **sundarurfriend**: 提到游戏图片主要来自美国和西欧等富裕国家，导致游戏有些单调，缺乏全球多样性。
  - **INTPenis**: 由于年份已经显示在红框中，不清楚需要选择年份，导致困惑。
  - **captn3m0**: 直到第三轮才明白时间选择器如何工作，之前一直被扣分。

• [技术问题与移动端体验]
  - **king_phil**: 在手机上体验不佳，出现无法滚动和缺少控件的问题。
  - **brahma-dev**: 提供了游戏在其设备上渲染的截图，可能暗示渲染问题。

• [图片与数据准确性]
  - **SamBam**: 发现游戏中一张照片的位置信息有误，与实际位置不符。
  - **pmxi**: 遇到照片中包含明显线索（如时代广场和1908年的版权信息），影响了猜测的挑战性。

• [替代方案与UX比较]
  - **Jordan-117**: 更喜欢该游戏的照片选择，认为像侦探工作，但希望游戏能在午夜重置。
  - **me_bx**: 提到“Whentaken”具有相同概念，并提供了链接，供感兴趣的用户参考。
  - **alexkearns**: 提到他们创建的美国总统时间线游戏，并提供了链接，虽然不完全相同，但也是一种替代选择。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：游戏图片来源的地理多样性不足，主要集中在富裕国家，导致部分用户（如sundarurfriend）感到无聊。
• 用户对游戏时间元素的评价普遍积极，认为增加了新的挑战和乐趣。
• 部分用户遇到技术问题和界面困惑，特别是在移动端和时间选择器使用上。

这些观点展示了用户对TimeGuessr及其类似游戏的多角度评价，涵盖了游戏玩法、技术实现和用户体验等方面。

data.title: Jemalloc Postmortem
data.author: jasone
data.article_summary: 本文回顾了jemalloc内存分配器的发展历程，分为几个阶段。2004年，作者最初为Lyken编程语言开发了手动内存分配器，但该语言项目未完成。随后，作者将该分配器集成到FreeBSD中，解决了多处理器环境下的可扩展性问题，但初期存在严重的内存碎片问题，最终通过算法改进解决。2007年，作者与Mozilla合作，将jemalloc移植到Linux和Windows，但Windows版本出现性能问题。2009年，作者加入Facebook，进一步改进jemalloc以支持内存泄露调试工具。此后，jemalloc在GitHub上继续发展，引入了测试基础设施、Valgrind支持和遥测功能，但也在5.0.0版本中因维护复杂性移除了Valgrind支持。目前，jemalloc已停止主动开发，但仍将无限期公开可用。

• Jemalloc在不同平台和应用场景中的性能优势和实际应用案例被多次提及，显示出其广泛的影响力。
• 关于Jemalloc为何未成为默认分配器的讨论，涉及技术决策、历史背景和平台特定需求等多方面因素。
• 争议的焦点之一是Jemalloc的维护和未来发展方向，特别是在其归档状态和潜在的设置调整方面。
• 其他分配器如Tcmalloc和mimalloc也被提及，引发了关于它们与Jemalloc的比较和各自优势的讨论。

总体来看，评论中对Jemalloc的评价普遍积极，但也反映出其在维护和普及上面临的实际挑战。

44264958.article_content:
Jason Evans
@jasone
Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, USA
Home
jemalloc Postmortem
Published Jun 12, 2025
The
jemalloc
memory allocator was first conceived in early 2004, and has
been in public use for about 20 years now. Thanks to the nature of open source software licensing,
jemalloc will remain publicly available indefinitely. But active upstream development has come to an
end. This post briefly describes jemalloc’s development phases, each with some success/failure
highlights, followed by some retrospective commentary.
Phase 0: Lyken
In 2004 I began work on the Lyken programming language in the context of scientific computing. Lyken
was an eventual dead end, but its manual memory allocator was functionally complete by May 2005.
(The garbage collector which was to leverage its features was never completed.) In September 2005 I
started integrating the allocator into FreeBSD, and in March 2006 I removed the allocator from
Lyken, in favor of thin wrappers around system allocator functionality.
Why remove the memory allocator from Lyken after so much effort went into it? Well, once the
allocator was integrated into FreeBSD, it became apparent that the only feature missing from the
system allocator was a mechanism for tracking allocation volume in order to trigger per thread
garbage collection. And that could be implemented via thin wrappers using thread-specific data and
dlsym(3)
. Interestingly, many years later
jemalloc even added the statistics gathering that Lyken would have needed.
Phase 1: FreeBSD
Back in 2005 the transition to multi-processor computers was ongoing. FreeBSD had Poul-Henning
Kamp’s excellent phkmalloc memory allocator, but that allocator had no provisions for parallel
thread execution. Lyken’s allocator seemed like an obvious scalability improvement, and with
encouragement from friends and colleagues I integrated what quickly became known as jemalloc. Ah,
but not so fast! Shortly after integration it became apparent that jemalloc had terrible
fragmentation issues under some loads, notably those induced by
KDE
applications. Just when I thought I was mostly done, this real-world failure called jemalloc’s
viability into question.
In brief, the fragmentation issue arose from using a unified extent allocation approach (i.e. no
size class segregation). I had taken basic inspiration from Doug Lea’s
dlmalloc
, but without the intertwined battle-tested
heuristics that avoided many of the worst fragmentation issues. Much frantic research and
experimentation ensued. By the time jemalloc was part of a FreeBSD release, its layout algorithms
had completely changed to use size-segregated regions, as described in the
2006 BSDCan jemalloc
paper
.
Phase 1.5: Firefox
In November 2007,
Mozilla Firefox
3 was nearing
release, and high fragmentation was an unresolved issue, especially on Microsoft Windows. Thus began
a year of working with Mozilla on memory allocation. Porting jemalloc to Linux was trivial, but
Windows was another matter. The canonical jemalloc sources were in the FreeBSD libc library, so we
essentially forked jemalloc and added portability code, upstreaming anything that was relevant to
FreeBSD. The entire implementation was still in one file, which reduced the friction of fork
maintenance, but the implementation complexity definitely surpassed what is reasonable in a single
file sometime during this phase of development.
Years later, Mozilla developers made significant contributions to the upstream jemalloc in an effort
to move away from their fork. Unfortunately, Mozilla benchmarks consistently showed that the forked
version outperformed the upstream version. I don’t know if this was due to overfitting to a local
optimum or an actual indication of performance regression, but it remains one of my biggest jemalloc
disappointments.
Phase 2: Facebook
When I started work at Facebook in 2009, I was surprised to discover that the biggest impediment to
ubiquitous jemalloc use in Facebook infrastructure was instrumentation. Critical internal services
were in the awkward situation of depending on jemalloc to keep memory fragmentation under control,
but engineers needed to debug memory leaks with
tcmalloc
and
the
pprof
heap profiling tool that is part of
gperftools
.
pprof
-compatible heap profiling
functionality headlined the jemalloc 1.0.0 release.
jemalloc development migrated to
GitHub
and continued sporadically
for the next few years as issues and opportunities arose. Other developers started contributing
significant functionality. Version 3.0.0 introduced extensive testing infrastructure, as well as
Valgrind
support. The 4.x release series introduced decay-based purging and
JSON
-formatted telemetry. The 5.x series transitioned from
“chunks” to “extents” to pave the way for better interaction with 2 MiB huge pages.
Somewhat more controversially, I removed Valgrind support in 5.0.0 because it was a significant
maintenance complication (numerous tendrils in subtle places), and it was unused inside Facebook;
44264958.article_summary: 本文回顾了jemalloc内存分配器的发展历程，分为几个阶段。2004年，作者最初为Lyken编程语言开发了手动内存分配器，但该语言项目未完成。随后，作者将该分配器集成到FreeBSD中，解决了多处理器环境下的可扩展性问题，但初期存在严重的内存碎片问题，最终通过算法改进解决。2007年，作者与Mozilla合作，将jemalloc移植到Linux和Windows，但Windows版本出现性能问题。2009年，作者加入Facebook，进一步改进jemalloc以支持内存泄露调试工具。此后，jemalloc在GitHub上继续发展，引入了测试基础设施、Valgrind支持和遥测功能，但也在5.0.0版本中因维护复杂性移除了Valgrind支持。目前，jemalloc已停止主动开发，但仍将无限期公开可用。

data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：ReFLeCT技术在捕捉未受约束、未麻醉的生物模型全层扫描图方面的创新性及其技术设计特点。

不同观点：
• reptation提供了多个视频链接以展示ReFLeCT技术的实际应用效果，但未直接发表观点。这些视频展示了该技术在多毫米三维视野中同步捕捉多个生物体全层扫描图的能力。

• JPL eRouzic引用了ReFLeCT技术的一个关键特性，强调该技术能够在每秒120个体积的速度下捕捉多个未受约束、未麻醉的生物模型的全层扫描图。这表明该技术在高速度和高通量方面的优势。

• gsf_emergency_2指出ReFLeCT设计中的一个关键元素是使用了一个反射凹面镜，这是其他从事傅里叶X领域的团队没有采用的方法。这暗示了该技术在设计上的创新性和独特性。

补充讨论：
• ReFLeCT技术的核心优势在于其能够同步捕捉多个生物模型的全层扫描图，这在研究未麻醉和未受约束的生物体时具有重要意义。
• gsf_emergency_2提到的反射凹面镜的使用可能是该技术的一个独特设计选择，使其在与其他类似技术比较时具有一定的竞争优势。
• JPL eRouzic对捕捉速度和体积的强调表明该技术在高通量应用中的潜力，可能为生物学研究提供新的实验方法和数据获取方式。

争议焦点：目前没有明显的争议，但讨论可能围绕ReFLeCT技术与其他类似技术在性能和应用场景上的比较展开。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：美国军方直接委任大科技公司高管为中校（Lieutenant Colonels）及其相关影响和争议

不同观点：
• **支持直接委任的观点**：
  - **snerbles**：通过直接委任课程（Direct Commissioning Course），高管们能够快速进入军队体系。这类似于让有专业背景的人（如医生）直接进入较高职位，以利用他们的专长。这种做法并不新鲜，且有其合理性。
  - **austin-cheney**：虽然中校（O5）通常需要15年左右的军事经验，但某些专业背景（如医生、律师）的人可以例外，直接以较高军衔进入军队。技术专家的加入可以帮助军队现代化，特别是在技术领域。

• **质疑和反对直接委任的观点**：
  - **bgwalter**：这种委任被视为一种“旋转门”现象，即军方与大科技公司之间的高管交流。这可能导致利益冲突，高管们可能会借此推销自己公司的产品。文中提到微软IVAS系统的失败例子，显示出这种合作可能带来的技术问题。
  - **pimlottc**：文中提到五角大楼的国防数字服务（Defense Digital Service）曾运作近十年，但后来被边缘化。这表明军方此前已有技术专家团队，不需要再通过直接委任大科技公司高管来提供技术建议。
  - **djeastm**：作为 former enlisted，认为这些来自私营部门的高管即使被委任为中校，也不会被真正视为与通过传统方式晋升的中校同等，尤其是在尊重和信任方面。
  - **oooyay**：质疑选择高管而非工程师来帮助军队现代化，这似乎不符合逻辑，因为工程师更具备实际技术技能。

• **法律与伦理问题**：
  - **kriro**：对高管们的动机提出质疑，认为他们可能获得某些内部利益，或者能否同时持有军职和公司职位，存在潜在的利益冲突。同时，认为选择高管而非有实际技术技能的人令人困惑。
  - **tempodox**：虽然有防火墙机制防止高管们在军队中为自己的公司谋利，但实际效果有待观察。

• **其他讨论**：
  - **Jtsummers**：质疑这种委任方式是否会导致高管们利用军方职位为自己的公司产品谋取利益，特别是在他们未来可能获得军队养老金的情况下。
  - **cutler**：提到大科技公司与军方的关系复杂，暗示这些高管的委任可能带来不必要的政治和军事干预，特别是涉及国际事务时。
  - **tdeck**：对高管们在军队中的法律义务和离职权利提出疑问，即他们是否能随时离开军队。
  - **jamesgill**：指出这种直接委任在陆军和海军中较为常见，但在其他军种中较少见，且通常用于医疗技能培训，而非如此高军衔的委任。

补充讨论：
- **争议的焦点**：主要集中在直接委任大科技公司高管是否合理、是否会导致利益冲突、以及这些高管能否在军队中发挥真正的作用。同时，讨论中也涉及军方与私营企业之间的复杂关系及其潜在影响。

data.title: Investigation into 4chan and its compliance with the Online Safety Act
data.author: intunderflow
data.article_summary: Ofcom已于2025年6月10日启动对在线讨论板4chan的调查，以确定其是否未遵守《2023年在线安全法》规定的义务。调查重点包括：4chan是否未响应法定信息请求，是否未进行并保存非法内容风险评估记录，以及是否未履行有关非法内容的安全职责。根据《在线安全法》第9和第10条，4chan应进行非法内容风险评估并采取适当措施防止和移除非法内容。然而，4chan未按要求在2025年3月16日前完成评估，且未回应Ofcom于2025年4月14日发出的信息通知。调查将评估4chan是否存在违反法定职责的情况，可能导致高达1800万英镑的罚款或强制措施。调查结果将适时更新。

Investigation into 4chan and its compliance with duties to protect its users from illegal content
Online safety
Illegal and harmful content
Enforcement
Published:
10 June 2025
Open
Investigation into
Online Discussion Board ‘4chan’
Case opened
10 June 2025
Summary
We are initiating an investigation to determine whether the online discussion board 4chan has failed—or is currently failing—to comply with its obligations under the Online Safety Act 2023. Our investigation will focus on potential breaches in the following areas:
Failure to respond to a statutory information request;
Failure to complete and keep a record of a suitable and sufficient illegal content risk assessment; and
Non-compliance with the safety duties about illegal content.
Relevant legal provision(s)
Sections 9, 10, 23(2) and 102(8) of the Online Safety Act 2023.
Opening text - 10 June 2025
Ofcom has today opened an investigation into the online discussion board ‘4chan’. The investigation will consider 4chan’s compliance with its duties under the Online Safety Act 2023 ('the Act').
Section 9(2) of the Act requires all user-to-user and search services in scope of the Act to undertake an illegal content risk assessment by 16 March 2025. Amongst other things, this requires services to assess the risks of users encountering illegal content on their platforms, including priority illegal content (as defined by the Act).
Section 10 of the Act imposes duties on providers of regulated user-to-user services to take or use:
proportionate measures to effectively mitigate and manage:
the risk of the service being used for the commission or facilitation of a priority offence; and
the risks of harm to individuals identified in their illegal content risk assessment.
proportionate systems and processes to:
prevent individuals from encountering priority illegal content; and
minimise the length of time for which any priority illegal content is present and to swiftly take down illegal content once they become aware of it.
Services must also include provisions in the terms of service specifying how individuals are to be protected from illegal content, apply those terms consistently and ensure the terms of service are clear and easily accessible.
These ‘Illegal Content Duties’ came into effect on 17 March 2025.
Regulated user-to-user service providers can comply with the Illegal Content Duties by implementing measures recommended in
Ofcom’s illegal content Codes of Practice for user-to-user services
issued on 24 February 2025 (the ‘Codes of Practice’), or through alternative measures.
Ofcom has powers under section 102(8) of the Act to require persons to respond to an information notice in the manner and form specified.
Investigation
On 14 April 2025, Ofcom issued a formal information notice to the provider of the service 4chan requesting a copy of the record of its Illegal Content Risk Assessment, as part of our
Risk Assessment Enforcement Programme
.
At the date of opening this investigation, no response has been received to the information notice.
Ofcom’s investigation will examine whether there are reasonable grounds to believe that 4chan has failed, or is failing, to comply with its duty to respond accurately to an information notice sent under the Act, as well as its duty to complete and keep a record of its Illegal Content Risk Assessment. The investigation will also consider whether there are reasonable grounds to believe that 4chan has failed, or is failing, to comply with its duties to protect its users from illegal content under section 10.
Ofcom’s
Online Safety Enforcement Guidance
sets out how Ofcom will normally approach enforcement under the Act. This includes our approach to information gathering and analysis and the procedural steps we must take to fairly determine the outcome of the investigation.
Where we identify compliance failures, we can impose fines of up to £18 million or 10% of qualifying worldwide revenue (whichever is greater). In the most serious cases of non-compliance, and where appropriate, given the risks of harm to individuals in the UK, we can seek a court order to require third parties to take action to disrupt the business of the provider. This may require third parties (such as providers of payment or advertising services, or Internet Service Providers) to withdraw services from, or block access to, a regulated service in the UK.
We will provide an update on this investigation in due course.

data.title: Helion: A modern fast paced Doom FPS engine in C#
data.author: klaussilveira
data.article_summary: Helion是一款现代、高性能的Doom引擎，专为提升性能而开发。它能够使复杂的Doom地图在现代GPU上流畅运行，甚至在旧硬件上也可玩。Helion采用静态渲染和状态管理系统，有效处理动态地图变化，相比传统的BSP树渲染大幅减少CPU负担，提升GPU利用率，从而显著提高性能。它支持多种WAD格式，最低要求为Windows 7、Linux及Open GL 3.3 GPU。Helion使用.NET 9，提供自含版，也支持从源码编译。用户可在Discord或Doomworld论坛参与讨论、报告问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：开源C#代码库Helion的实现及其相关技术讨论

不同观点：
• [bob1029] 认为应使用内置的numerics库（如Vector4F）而非手动实现类型，因为内置库利用了SIMD等优化技术，且微软投入了大量资源进行优化。
• [energywut] 提到了MyHouse.wad文件，并将其与艺术作品《House of Leaves》联系起来，暗示对该项目在创意内容上的潜在应用感兴趣。
• [ngrilly] 赞扬Helion作为一个现代C#开源代码库，不像J2EE那样复杂，提供了一个更简洁的实现。
• [Cieric] 对性能图表提出了一个小建议，认为应该使用柱状图而非折线图，因为不同GPU之间没有“中间状态”。
• [_0ffh] 开玩笑说，作为一个Doom引擎，项目没命名为“Hellion”是错失机会。

补充讨论：
• [dimitropoulos] 提到Helion对Doom in TypeScript项目的贡献，并表达了对Nick的感谢，因其帮助解决了引擎中一些晦涩问题。
• [yodon] 对C#的高性能表示印象深刻。
• [bee_rider] 以幽默方式表达了对在2khz显示器上玩Doom的期待。
• [mawadev] 对基准测试图表表示怀疑，质疑是否所有引擎都未限制帧率且关闭了垂直同步（vsync），认为图表有些奇怪但仍认可其性能表现。
• [reverseblade2] 提出使用MemoryStream的替代方案RecyclableMemoryStream，暗示在某些情况下后者可能更合适。
• [thomasqbrady] 关心项目的许可方式，询问是否可以用来开发和销售独立游戏。
• [patrick4urcloud] 表示会尝试使用该项目。
• [neuroelectron] 提出FPS游戏应每毫秒更新屏幕，质疑为何这种做法不更普遍。

争议焦点：
• 对基准测试图表的质疑，[mawadev]认为图表设计不合理且可能存在帧率和同步设置问题。
• 对使用内置numerics库的建议，[bob1029]认为这是更优选择，但未见其他人对此做出直接回应。

其他值得注意的讨论点：
• 项目命名被开玩笑地提出，[_0ffh]认为应更具创意。
• 许可问题对开发者的实际影响，[thomasqbrady]关心是否可以用此项目开发商业游戏。
• 对内存管理类的讨论，[reverseblade2]提出了MemoryStream的替代方案。

Helion
A modern Doom engine written from the ground up with a focus on performance.
Content creators have created maps that struggle to render at high framerates with even the latest and most expensive hardware. With Helion, Doom’s most complex maps are no longer stressful on modern GPUs and playable on old hardware that was previously impossible.
Helion uses static rendering with a state management system to reconcile dynamic map changes in Doom. In contrast to the typical BSP tree rendering that requires significant CPU processing, Helion is able to manage dynamic changes and optimally utilize the GPU resulting in dramatic performance increases.
Helion supports WADs targeting vanilla, Boom, MBF, MBF21, UDMF (partial support), and ID24.
Minimum requirements are Windows 7 or Linux and an Open GL 3.3 capable GPU.

Helion uses .NET 9. The self-contained Helion releases include it, otherwise Windows users will need to
install the Desktop Runtime
, and Linux users will need to follow the
instructions for their distro
. On Linux, you will also need to make sure OpenAL, libsndfile, and libmpg123 are installed.
For information on setting up and playing, see the bundled
game documentation
.

If you encounter issues using Helion and would like to report a bug, you can do so either
here on GitHub Issues

data.title: Geometry from Quantum Temporal Correlations
data.author: ljosifov
data.article_summary: 这篇文章探讨了量子时间关联如何生成欧几里得三维空间几何结构。作者通过研究在单量子比特上连续测量保罗利可观测量所产生的量子时间关联，发现这些关联独立于量子比特的初始状态。这意味着观察者无需知道初始条件即可提取几何信息，暗示空间可能源自量子时间关联。文章还提出了一种假设现象的简单模型来解释这一可能性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对某篇理论物理学论文及其观点的专业性和可信度进行讨论，涉及空间时间的概念、量子物理中的数学工具（如Pauli矩阵）的应用以及相关学术背景。

不同观点：
• **patcon**：对论文的评估能力有限，但提到第二作者具有较高的学术声望，并引用了Google Scholar的链接以提供社会证明。此外，提到Sabine Hossenfelder的一个相关视频，以帮助理解该论文。

• **stared**：对论文的开头声明提出质疑，认为关于理论物理学界对空间时间的一致看法的说法并不准确。此外，指出使用Pauli矩阵来论证1+3空间时间可能是一种循环论证，因为Pauli矩阵与空间有直接关联（如Dirac旋量和四元数）。

• **magicalhippo**：提到一个关于从量子涨落中出现洛伦兹签名和时间维度的演讲，描述了从均匀4D度规引入不对称“噪声”到背景场的过程，认为这听起来很有趣，但作为外行无法深入评论。

• **ljosifov**：提到Vlatko Vedral的一场演讲，并提供了链接，表明通过阅读演讲的文字记录来辅助观看视频内容。

• **tomrod**：表示对论文中空间是量子层面的相关相互作用的论点不太理解，但认为这个话题很有趣。同时，提出一个与学术阅读相关的想法，建议开发一种基于LLM的工具，帮助用户钻研学术概念。

• **nyeah**：询问是否有物理学家愿意评论，特别关注Pauli矩阵是否仅用于处理三个空间轴，并质疑论文是否有更多深层次的内容。

• **neom**：提到最近在Hacker News上看到的一篇长论文，讨论了Jaeger等人的意识理论，认为几何等宏观层面的“既定事实”可能从深层的非经典过程中涌现出来，类似于“程序生成的量子现实”。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：主要集中在论文开头关于空间时间共识声明的可信度，以及使用Pauli矩阵论证空间时间结构是否构成循环论证。
• 其他讨论：包括对量子涨落和空间时间出现过程的兴趣，以及对学术阅读工具的建议，反映了跨学科思考和学术阅读体验的改进需求。

Abstract:
In this work, we show how Euclidean 3-space uniquely emerges from the structure of quantum temporal correlations associated with sequential measurements of Pauli observables on a single qubit. Quite remarkably, the quantum temporal correlations which give rise to geometry are independent of the initial state of the qubit, which we show enables an observer to extract geometric data from sequential measurements without the observer having any knowledge of initial conditions. Such results suggest the plausibility that space itself may emerge from quantum temporal correlations, and we formulate a toy model of such a hypothetical phenomenon.

44268286.article_summary: 这篇文章探讨了量子时间关联如何生成欧几里得三维空间几何结构。作者通过研究在单量子比特上连续测量保罗利可观测量所产生的量子时间关联，发现这些关联独立于量子比特的初始状态。这意味着观察者无需知道初始条件即可提取几何信息，暗示空间可能源自量子时间关联。文章还提出了一种假设现象的简单模型来解释这一可能性。

• **patcon**：对论文的评估能力有限，但提到第二作者具有较高的学术声望，并引用了Google Scholar的链接以提供社会证明。此外，提到Sabine Hossenfelder的一个相关视频，以帮助理解该论文。

• **magicalhippo**：提到一个关于从量子涨落中出现洛伦兹签名和时间维度的演讲，描述了从均匀4D度规引入不对称“噪声”到背景场的过程，认为这听起来很有趣，但作为外行无法深入评论。

McWig (temporary name)
Hi! Welcome to my text editor page.
McWig is a modal, Vim-like text editor written in Go. I use it as my daily driver, btw.
Note:
McWig currently supports only
.go
files. Do not edit files that are not backed up. McWig is still in an early stage of development and may damage your files.
Features
LSP autocomplete, goto definition, hover info
Tree-sitter support
Color themes (borrowed from the Helix text editor)
Lots of bugs
Macro support
Something like Emacs org-mode: Open
test.txt
, place the cursor at line 15, and press
"Ctrl-C Ctrl-C"
.
This project was written as a "speed run" — not for speed in terms of time, but rather as an exercise to explore the text editor problem space without overthinking or planning ahead. It’s a quick and "dirty" implementation, so to speak.
Running
make setup-runtime
make build-run
Keybindings
Most common Vim keybindings are implemented, providing minimal but enough (for me) support for daily source code editing. See
config/config.go
for all implemented keybindings.

data.title: 1k year old 3 sisters crop farm found in Northern Michigan
data.author: CoopaTroopa
data.article_summary: 祖先的梅诺米尼人在密歇根上半岛通过建造土丘种植玉米、豆类和南瓜。这些土丘构成了美国东部保存最大的考古农田系统。2023年5月，考古学家使用激光雷达技术发现了这些土丘，它们位于密歇根和威斯康星边界的梅诺米尼河地区，被称为“狗的肚子”（Anaem Omot）。这些土丘大约在1000年前建造，并使用了600年。研究显示，土丘系统比之前认为的大十倍，表明梅诺米尼人投入大量劳动进行农业活动。尽管当时气候较冷，生长季节短，但土丘农业仍繁荣发展。此外，考古学家还发现炭屑和陶器碎片，表明这些农民可能用家庭废物作堆肥。研究为理解前殖民时期的梅诺米尼人生活提供了重要视角。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对古代农业实践（三姐妹种植系统）的探讨及其相关发现，包括与现代农业的比较和历史知识的恢复。

不同观点：
• romanhn：指出评论中对"三姐妹"系统的困惑，并提供维基百科链接以帮助理解。该评论偏向解释和提供信息。
• mapotofu：认为此次发现的农业实践类似于南美的Terra preta（黑土），并推测这种做法可能在整个美洲广泛使用。同时表达了对更多类似发现被揭露的希望，强调了原住民农业技能的精湛。
• folli：提到自己正在进行的与LiDAR数据相关的工作，并提供GitHub链接，虽然与主要讨论点相关性较小，但提供了技术应用的实例。
• steve_adams_86：提出疑问，讨论过去作物是否因为适应气候而生长得更好，或者是否存在已经消失的作物品种。还猜测是否可能将玉米用作三姐妹系统中的支撑作物，而非主要粮食作物，提出了历史农业实践中的潜在变化。
• firesteelrain：赞赏古代农业实践中的智慧和创造力，强调这些实践需要大量的规划和协调，侧重于对古人技能的正面评价。
• jfengel：对该地区仍保留古代遗迹表示惊讶，推测该地区曾被砍伐，并可能计划再次开发为农田。
• Scarblac：提问是否有欧亚大陆上与三姐妹系统类似的原住民农业实践，将讨论扩展到不同地域的农业历史。

• 技术应用：folli提供的LiDAR数据链接为讨论增添了现代技术在考古和农业历史研究中的应用维度。
• 地域扩展：Scarblac的问题将讨论从美洲原住民农业实践扩展到欧亚大陆，显示出对跨文化农业历史比较的兴趣。

44257422.article_content:
Ancestral Menominee farmers grew corn, beans and squash in earthen mounds they built on Michigan's Upper Peninsula.
Madeleine McLeester
Hundreds of years before the arrival of the first Europeans, Indigenous farmers were growing crops like squash, corn and beans in earthen mounds they built on Michigan’s Upper Peninsula.
The mounds—created by the ancestors of the
Menominee Indian Tribe of Wisconsin
—likely represent the largest preserved archaeological field system in the eastern United States, according to a study published this month in the journal
Science
.
Archaeologists discovered the mounds in May 2023 during the brief window between winter and spring. The winter snow had melted, but the leaves had not yet appeared on the trees. They surveyed 330 acres using a drone equipped with a laser that mapped subtle features on the surface—a remote sensing technique known as
lidar
.
The team mapped an area that has cultural and historical importance to the Menominee. Located along the Menominee River on the Michigan-Wisconsin border, this region is known as Anaem Omot, or the “Dog’s Belly.”
The lidar uncovered a quilt-like pattern of parallel ridges that range from four to 12 inches tall. The mounds extend beyond the study area, suggesting the ancestral Menominee agricultural system was ten times larger than previously thought.
In August 2023, scientists returned to the site and took samples from three of the earthen mounds located various distances from the Menominee River. Radiocarbon dating suggests the ridges were initially constructed roughly 1,000 years ago. They were maintained and used for 600 years after that.
Researchers mapped an area along the Menominee River on the Michigan-Wisconsin border.
McLeester et al. / Science, 2025
The fact that the mounds still exist is unusual.
“Most field systems have been either lost or destroyed due to intensive land use across most of North America, through farming, including pastures and the cutting down of trees for urban development,” says co-author
Jesse Casana
, an anthropologist at Dartmouth College, in a
statement
.
The research gives scientists a “little window” into what pre-colonial life was like for the ancestral Menominee people, Casana adds.
During their excavations, the scientists also found several artifacts, including charcoal and fragments of broken ceramics. These discoveries suggest that the area’s Indigenous farmers may have dumped their household waste and the remnants of fires onto their fields, using them as compost. Samples taken from the mounds suggest the farmers enriched the dirt with soil from nearby wetlands.
The results indicate that ancestral Menominee people dedicated a lot of time and energy to agriculture in a remote area. The team has not found any significant settlement sites in the region—only a few small villages.
“It requires a lot of labor to create these fields, to clear the forest,” says
Susan Kooiman
, an anthropologist at Southern Illinois University Edwardsville who was not involved with the research, to
NPR
’s Nell Greenfieldboyce. “This is dense forest, now and then. To clear it, only with stone tools, is a lot of labor, a lot of work. … The amount of work, and just how far these fields extend, is beyond anything that I think people suspected was going on this far north in eastern North America.”
Scientists remain perplexed by the location of the mounds. At the time, the area was undergoing a colder climatic period called the Little Ice Age. The lower temperatures, in addition to the already short growing season on the Upper Peninsula, would have made it very difficult to grow crops, particularly corn.
And who were the ancestral Menominee farmers growing the crops for? What were they doing with their bounty? Perhaps they needed to feed a growing population, or they wanted to have a surplus in case they ran out of other foods, lead author
Madeleine McLeester
, an archaeologist at Dartmouth, tells
Science News
’ Bruce Bower. Maybe they were growing the crops for trade.
The lidar survey also uncovered a dance ring (A), a historic building foundation (B), a 19th-century logging camp (C), looted burial mounds (D), remains of the Backlund mound group (E) and another burial mound (F).
McLeester et al. / Science, 2025
These and other mysteries remain. But the findings in “an area where we would not expect intensive agriculture,” seem to suggest that “much of the eastern U.S. was once covered in Native American agricultural ridges,” McLeester adds.
The ridges were not a complete surprise, as the recent survey was building off similar research conducted in the 1990s. Current Menominee tribal authorities invited scientists to return and investigate the area again using more advanced technologies.
The scientists collaborated with Menominee leaders and representatives, including David Grignon, a historic preservation officer for the Menominee Indian Tribe of Wisconsin, and the late
David Overstreet
, an archaeologist who worked close
44257422.article_summary: 祖先的梅诺米尼人在密歇根上半岛通过建造土丘种植玉米、豆类和南瓜。这些土丘构成了美国东部保存最大的考古农田系统。2023年5月，考古学家使用激光雷达技术发现了这些土丘，它们位于密歇根和威斯康星边界的梅诺米尼河地区，被称为“狗的肚子”（Anaem Omot）。这些土丘大约在1000年前建造，并使用了600年。研究显示，土丘系统比之前认为的大十倍，表明梅诺米尼人投入大量劳动进行农业活动。尽管当时气候较冷，生长季节短，但土丘农业仍繁荣发展。此外，考古学家还发现炭屑和陶器碎片，表明这些农民可能用家庭废物作堆肥。研究为理解前殖民时期的梅诺米尼人生活提供了重要视角。

data.title: How to modify Starlink Mini to run without the built-in WiFi router
data.author: LorenDB
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了如何移除Starlink Mini 1终端内的内置Wi-Fi路由器板，使其仅通过以太网运行，从而为高级用户提供更大的灵活性。该过程需要小心拆解，使用金属撬棍和塑料撬具，并注意不要移除金属板，因为它既是散热器又是电磁干扰（EMI）屏蔽层。文章详细说明了连接器的引脚分布和直接以太网连接方法，强调了使用以太网变压器和保持短接线的重要性。终端在未连接卫星时提供192.168.100.1的DHCP IP地址，并通过gRPC接口提供监控数据。连接到Starlink网络后，用户需添加静态路由以访问终端。注意，此修改仅适用于Starlink Mini 1，未来型号可能不适用。

44282017.article_content:
The Starlink Mini terminal is designed as a compact, all-in-one solution with an integrated Wi-Fi router. While this design is ideal for typical consumer use, certain applications—such as custom networking setups, embedded installations, or power-constrained environments—may benefit from removing the internal router entirely. In this article, I’ll detail the process of physically removing the built-in Wi-Fi router board from the Starlink Mini, allowing the terminal to operate solely via Ethernet and offering greater flexibility for advanced users.
Please note that this modification applies only to the Starlink Mini 1 (as of June 14, 2025). Hardware changes in future models, such as the expected Mini 2, may render this process invalid.
Starlink Mini teardown
The disassembly process requires patience and accuracy. I recommend using metal spudgers and a plastic prying tool.
Additionally, you will need a thin, flexible knife or a thin metal wire to remove the router’s PCB.
I prepared a video manual about the teardown process.
Please note that there is no need to remove the metal plate from the Starlink PCB. You can stop the teardown process after removing the router’s PCB.
Removing the metal plate is
strongly discouraged
. This plate serves as both a
heatsink
and an
EMI shield
.
The Starlink CPU runs hot, and without proper cooling, it may throttle the CPU or antenna array. In addition, the plate is glued around the corners with
conductive adhesive
to ensure effective electromagnetic shielding. The Starlink Mini PCB generates
significant EMI
, and SpaceX reportedly faced challenges achieving compliance.
Removing the plate can lead to increased emissions and potential
interference
with nearby electronics.
Starlink Mini PCB connector
The exact type of the connector is unknown. It might be a custom order. But the pitch of the connector is 2 mm, so any
standard
2 mm header will fit here nicely.
You may notice that this connector is secured with a similar conductive adhesive and a large non-masked grounding area. Additionally, a shield is placed over the connector on the router’s PCB.
This is all done to help contain the EMI.
Connector pinout
Starlink Mini uses a 1 Gbps Ethernet link between the primary unit and the router. Please note that there is no Ethernet transformer; instead, a direct
PHY-to-PHY
connection with some decoupling is used. This is acceptable for short distances. With any custom design installation, the Ethernet transformer is mandatory.
The primary voltage bus is 12 VDC.
The connector pinout (Starlink Mini side) is in the picture below. The connector pinout (Starlink Mini side) is in the image below.
Ethernet line signals are mapped to the corresponding T568B twisted cable colors. Pins 11, 14, 16, 17, and 18 are not used in the current modification and mainly serve Starlink-Router monitoring purposes.
It’s recommended to use all 12 VDC and GND lines.
A reference image to help you identify pins:
Direct Ethernet connection
Below, you can see an example schematic of the direct Ethernet connection to the Starlink Mini_1 PCB connector. This schematic provides required Ethernet isolation and minimal power filtering to ensure proper operation.
It’s recommended to put a guard ground around the U1 connector. The most optimal design includes conductive adhesive and shielding.
Please, keep wires between the connector and Ethernet transformer as short as possible.
Nominal runtime current over
12V
is
~3A
with short spikes up to
5A
.
Please select the
L1
with the appropriate rated current to avoid overheating.
Proof-of-concept using my
Ethermod
adapter:
Network configuration
The Starlink terminal provides a
DHCP
IP address in the
192.168.100.0/24
network when not connected to Starlink satellites.
The terminal itself is available at address
192.168.100.1
, running a simple web UI and gRPC monitoring/control server.
It’s convenient to get Starlink debug data using
grpcurl
. Example request (getting the current status of the terminal):
grpcurl -plaintext -d {\"get_status\":{}} 192.168.100.1:9200
SpaceX.API.Device.Device/Handle
After connecting to the Starlink network, the Ethernet interface provides a
tunneled DHCP
service, assigning clients IP addresses from the Starlink pool – typically a CGNAT IPv4 address (e.g., 100.72.116.102) and a link-global IPv6 address. This network configuration provides access to the Internet.
Please note that the Starlink DHCP server provides only a single IP address. Therefore, you can connect only one host or an upstream router directly to share the connection with multiple devices.
After acquiring the “external” IP address, your client naturally loses access to the
192.168.100.1
host.
To fix this, you can add a static route to the terminal:
sudo ip route add 192.168.100.1 dev ethX
Replace
ethX
with the name of your Ethernet interface connected to Starlink.

不同观点：
• [Dwedit] 认为YouTube视频中的Tandy 1000 RSX电脑描述不准确。他指出，虽然该型号在1991年推出并拥有Super VGA图形能力，但它并没有默认配备Adlib或Sound Blaster声卡，尽管可以自行安装。此外，RSX配备了386处理器和1MB内存，不同于早期Tandy 1000系列的286处理器。

• [zkmon] 对现代技术复杂性增加表示遗憾，怀念过去计算机的简约和“足够”的功能性，认为不断变化的技术标准就像让人们不断追求无法达到的完美。

• [Disposal8433] 分享了自己过去使用PC喇叭玩游戏的经历，认为MIDI版本的音乐缺乏PC喇叭特有的“原始电子力量”。

• [kelwie] 对过去媒体播放器可以直接播放MIDI文件表示惊讶，并对比了现代Linux系统上播放MIDI文件的复杂性，希望现代播放器能像过去的Windows媒体播放器一样简单易用。

补充讨论：

• [burnt-resistor] 指出不同声卡对MIDI文件的渲染不同，因此没有统一的音效。
• [eminence32] 回忆了过去的媒体播放器界面设计。

• 主要集中在视频中Tandy 1000 RSX的描述是否准确，特别是关于其图形能力和声卡配置的细节。

data.title: Childhood leukemia: how a deadly cancer became treatable
data.author: surprisetalk
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了儿童白血病的治疗进展，特别是过去50年间生存率的显著提高。在20世纪70年代之前，不到10%的患儿能存活五年，而现在北美和欧洲的存活率达到约85%。文章解释了白血病是儿童最常见的癌症，尤其是急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）和急性髓细胞白血病（AML）。大多数儿童白血病是由细胞快速分裂过程中自发产生的基因突变引起的，而非遗传或环境因素。通过多年的研究和临床试验，治疗方法大幅改善，ALL的五年生存率从20世纪60年代的14%上升到2010年代的94%。AML的生存率也有所提高，但治疗难度较大。总体来看，现代医学显著提高了儿童白血病的治愈率和长期生存率。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：儿童急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）治疗进展及其相关问题

不同观点：
• [robwwilliams] 认为文章未充分解释如何为个体患者确定“正确的剂量”，并强调了基因分型技术在确定关键基因变异（如药物转运蛋白、代谢基因和排泄率调控基因）方面的重要性。他还指出，尽管药物库没有显著变化，但缓解率和生存率有显著提高。
• [CobaltFire] 分享了个人经历，其儿子在2020年被诊断出患有B-ALL，并参与了儿童肿瘤学小组的实验性治疗。他提到男性患者因癌症可能在睾丸中潜伏而接受额外治疗，但数据表明这种做法可能不必要且有负面影响。
• [akharris] 提到其父亲作为儿科血液肿瘤学家在60年代的工作，强调研究和临床护理的进步使得治愈率提高，并表达了对未来医学发展的乐观态度。
• [rglover] 以自身经历为例，强调了长期化疗对生活的深远影响，并希望全球儿童都能获得可负担的治疗。

补充讨论：
• [Vinnl] 赞扬了科学和医学的进步，指出尽管这些贡献不像拯救溺水儿童那样直观，但它们拯救了更多生命。
• [find] 通过简单的计算说明，现代儿童相比70年代的儿童更少接触到因癌症死亡的病例，反映出治疗进展的显著性。
• [bglazer] 提到了Don Pinkel在60年代对儿童ALL治疗的 pioneering 贡献，将治愈率从零提升到约50%。
• [ErigmolCt] 指出这些医学进展主要在高收入国家实现，全球推广是下一个前沿问题。
• [fakedang] 提到文章未提及的关键生物疗法药物asparaginase，及其短缺问题，尤其是在发展中国家的影响。
• [searine] 强调了政府资助的基础科学研究的重要性，并批评当前试图削减这种资助的努力。
• [srean] 表达了对进步的感恩。
• [bitwize] 回忆了X世代经历的儿童白血病死亡现象，并感慨现代儿童不再需要面对这种悲剧。

争议焦点：
• 治疗剂量的个性化与基因分型技术在实际应用中的重要性和未被文章充分说明的问题。
• 实验性治疗（如CobaltFire提到的男性额外治疗）的必要性和数据支持的有效性。
• asparaginase药物短缺对全球治疗进展的影响及其未被文章提及的疏漏。

44282143.article_content:
Home
Cancer
In the past, when I’d hear the words childhood leukemia, I’d picture a young child who suddenly became seriously ill, and whose parents were told their child had only a few years to live.
I’d wonder how a child might grasp the idea of limited time, or how painful it must have been to face the possibility of missing out on growing up, discovering who they are, and forming deep friendships. It would also be a tragic experience for their family, friends, and classmates, who might struggle to understand what’s happening.
This picture, reflected in films, books, and television, depicts what used to be a grim reality. Childhood leukemia was fatal for the vast majority of children who developed it in the past. Before the 1970s, fewer than 10% of children diagnosed with the disease survived five years after diagnosis.
But since then, this outlook has improved dramatically. In North America and Europe, around 85% now survive that long.
1
What made this dramatic change possible? In this article, I’ll describe the progress achieved and some concrete reasons behind it.
This article focuses on data from North America and Europe; death rates from childhood cancers have also
declined in other world regions
, but remain higher.
Leukemia is the most common childhood cancer, and its mortality rates have been reduced substantially
Many different types of cancer can affect children. This article focuses on leukemia, the most common type of childhood cancer.
In the chart below, you can see the reduction in cancer death rates in the United States among children of different ages. The decline has been particularly large for leukemia, with a 14-fold drop, but we’ve also made much progress on
other, less common childhood cancers
.

an interactive chart
.
Leukemia is a cancer of the blood and bone marrow — the tissue that produces blood cells. It develops when immature white blood cells grow out of control and crowd out healthy ones, leading to symptoms like fatigue, infections, easy bruising or bleeding, and pale skin.
While leukemia becomes more common with age, it’s the most frequent cancer in children, making up about a quarter of all childhood cancer cases in the United States.
2
One reason may be that blood-forming tissues are especially active during childhood, when the body grows quickly and needs a steady supply of new blood cells to carry oxygen, fight infections, and form clots. Many of these cells also have short lifespans, and this stage of life is a crucial period for immune system development.
3
This is very demanding for the bone marrow, which must constantly produce new cells. Each time a cell divides, there’s a small chance of a DNA error, and the more divisions that occur, the greater the chance that some of these errors will lead to cancer.
There are two main types of leukemia in children. The most common is
acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL)
, which starts in early lymphoid cells. The other is
acute myeloid leukemia (AML)
, which begins in other blood-forming cells.
4
Most childhood leukemia cases result from genetic mutations that develop spontaneously during this rapid cell division, often occurring before birth, while others are due to inherited genetic mutations, which are less common.
5
While several environmental exposures have been investigated, there hasnʼt been consistent evidence for any environmental causes.
6
Childhood leukemia has become much more treatable
Survival rates for children with leukemia have risen dramatically in the last 50 years.
The chart below plots overall survival rates — the share of children still alive after a given time since their diagnosis. The data comes from trials by the Children’s Oncology Group, which has enrolled tens of thousands of children since the 1960s, and now includes over half of all children with leukemia in the US.
7
The top panel displays this for acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) while the bottom panel shows acute myeloid leukemia (AML).
In the top panel, you can see that in the 1960s, only around 14% of children with acute lymphoblastic leukemia survived at least five years. Despite initially improving upon treatment, most relapsed and died soon after.
By the 2010s, the chances of survival had increased dramatically: 94% of children survived at least five years.
Some might wonder whether treatment only delays death rather than being a cure. However, researchers have also analyzed survival rates over the long term and found large improvements: the chart shows that most children are still alive ten years after diagnosis. After the initial years of treatment, their long-term survival is much more stable.
Download image
The bottom panel of the chart shows the improvement for acute myeloid leukemia. This subtype, which makes up about 25% of childhood leukemia cases, is more challenging to treat than acute lymphoblastic leukemia. Survival rates for this form have also improved, though not quite a

data.title: Show HN: Meow – An Image File Format I made because PNGs and JPEGs suck for AI
data.author: kuberwastaken
data.article_summary: MEOW（Metadata Encoded Optimized Webfile）是一个基于Python的图像文件格式，设计目标是高效、实用且跨平台兼容。它支持RGBA透明度和元数据，并具有快速渲染能力，适合AI工作流。MEOW通过隐写术将AI元数据嵌入PNG文件，使其成为增强版PNG，同时保持与标准PNG viewer的兼容性。通过简单设置，.meow文件可以在任何图像 viewer 中显示为PNG，而AI应用可以读取其中的隐藏元数据。MEOW专为AI设计，嵌入了预计算的AI特征和优化参数，增强了机器学习工作流的效率和LLM（大语言模型）对图像的理解。其隐写术存储技术通过将元数据编码在像素的最低有效位中，确保元数据在文件操作中不被丢失。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：自定义图像文件格式的必要性和有效性

不同观点：
• Gavinray认为，使用自定义文件格式（如带有元数据的自定义PNG格式）是一种低效且过度设计的方案，不如将普通图像和JSON/XML元数据文件打包成.tar.gz文件更为直接和简便。
• A2128指出，如果元数据可以自动计算，那么AI训练和推理流程也能做到，因此没有必要创建新的文件格式来存储这些预计算的特征。而且，随着模型和技术的进步，这些特征可能会过时。
• Ai_critic认为，使用现有的文件格式（如PNG和TGA）已经可以支持任意文本块和元数据的存储，因此没有必要引入非标准文件格式。现有的工具（如exiftool）已经可以完成这些工作。
• Zdw建议将元数据作为附加扩展存储，而不是创建新的文件格式，例如使用.drawio.png这样的扩展名。
• RamblingCTO认为，元数据被剥离其实是一种安全特性，而不是缺陷。
• Jfengel对使用隐写术存储元数据表示一定支持，但指出这需要大量的冗余和错误校正，可能会影响图像质量。
• Jbverschoor建议使用JXL格式，它支持多通道和任意元数据存储，并且支持有损和无损压缩。
• Kookamamie认为，将元数据作为JSON或Protobuf文件附加存储是更好的做法。
• Fao_指出，将元数据直接嵌入图像像素中会使其更加脆弱，容易在图像被修改或重新编码时丢失。
• Fao_还提到，现有的多种新图像格式（如WebP、JPEG 2000、HEIF、JPEG XL）都已经支持自定义元数据，没有必要创建新的文件格式。
• Faoo_进一步批评了当前AI趋势下许多人提出的“新想法”往往缺乏深度和实践经验，导致时间和资源的浪费。
• Ahofmann认为，在受控环境中使用这种方法可能有用，但在不受控的环境中，元数据很容易丢失。
• Daeken批评该方法使用最简单的隐写术技术（如直接将元数据放入像素的最低有效位），缺乏冗余和错误校正，是不合理的。
• Nnunley质疑主要目标是否只是为了创建一个看起来很酷的文件扩展名，并建议使用PNG内置的zTXt块存储元数据更为标准和可靠。
• Nnunley还指出，这种方法可能会被用来嵌入误导性的元数据，从而“毒害”模型。
• Refulgentis对该项目的整体质量和文档表示强烈批评，认为这是对已有技术的重复发明，且缺乏深度理解。

补充讨论：
• 使用现有文件格式和工具（如PNG的文本块和exiftool）是否足够满足元数据存储需求。
• 自定义文件格式或隐写术方法在实际应用中的脆弱性和潜在安全问题。
• 随着AI技术的发展，预计算特征和元数据的时效性和适用性。
• 对当前AI趋势下“新想法”缺乏深度和实践经验的批评。

争议焦点：是否需要创建新的自定义文件格式来存储图像元数据，或者使用现有格式和方法是否足够。

MEOW
The most Purr-fect Image File Format for your AI workflows
Wait- What? You Can Just Make File Formats?
Well- yes, but no, I'll come to that bit later, but before that, let me geek out about what this project is
MEOW
(Metadata Encoded Optimized Webfile) is a Python-based image file format designed to be efficient, practical, and cross-platform compatible.
With support for RGBA transparency, metadata, and fast rendering capabilities, MEOW provides a modern alternative for image storage and manipulation.
Whether you're a developer looking for a lightweight image format, an AI locked-in person to use the best possible file fomat, a digital artist needing transparent image support, or just a curious coder who wants a .meow file extension, MEOW offers a simple yet powerful solution.
The First image to ever be converted to .meow
Note: GitHub doesn't support .meow files (YET), so had to display the original PNG source
Why is it called MEOW?
The Problem with "Innovative" File Formats
MEOW
started off as just a fun, new (very ineffecient) image file format I made studying about them as a meme while having better metadata to be used with AI, but I realised something.
People don't make new file formats simply because of one problem- they're very hard to bring to mass adoption, what if we fix that?
Cross-Compatibility With PNGs
MEOW uses a steganographic image format that embeds rich AI metadata while maintaining PNG compatibility. It's basically PNGs on Steroids.
How it's less of a headache
Unlike traditional formats that require special viewers,
MEOW files contain standard PNG data
:
✅
Works in ANY image viewer
after simple setup (2 options below)
✅
Option 1: Rename to
.png
- instant compatibility everywhere
✅
Option 2: File association setup
- makes
.meow
extension recognized
✅
Hidden AI data
invisible to standard viewers, visible to AI
✅
Cross-platform compatibility
(Windows, macOS, Linux)
Setup Required
: Either rename
.meow
→
.png
OR run file association scripts
📱 Standard Viewer (Setup Required)
↓ Method 1: Rename test.meow → test.png
↓ Method 2: Run file association script
🖼️ Result: Opens as beautiful PNG image
🤖 AI-Aware App
↓ Opens .meow file directly (or renamed .png)
🧠 Sees: Image + Rich AI metadata
Perfect for AI Applications
MEOW is specifically designed for use with AI, embedding metadata that accelerates machine learning workflows and enhances LLM image understanding:
Problems with Current Formats
Metadata can very easily be stripped
- when images are processed or shared
Limited to basic descriptive information
- not optimized for AI
Separate from actual image processing
- requires additional steps
Not designed for machine learning workflows
Performance Benefits
Reduced preprocessing time
with embedded parameters
Consistent input formats
across different models
Training data enrichment
with embedded annotations
Enhanced LLM understanding
with structured metadata
Multimodal AI acceleration
for vision-language models
MEOW's AI-Optimized Advantages
MEOW doesn't just store metadata - it embeds AI-specific intelligence that traditional formats can't handle. When any image is converted to a .meow, this data is automatically added in the conversion process:
Pre-computed AI Features
Optimal preprocessing parameters embedded in the file
Attention maps showing where AI models should focus
Bounding boxes and object detection data
Saliency regions for computer vision tasks
Model Optimization Data
Steganographic Storage
Unlike traditional metadata that's easily lost:
Encoded in pixel LSBs (Least Significant Bits)
Survives file operations that would strip normal metadata
Invisible to standard viewers but accessible to AI applications
How Steganographic Storage Works
MEOW uses
LSB (Least Significant Bit) steganography
to hide AI data inside standard PNG images:
The Technical Magic
Load standard PNG image
into memory
Compress AI metadata
using zlib compression
Hide data in pixel LSBs
(2 bits per RGB channel = 6 bits/pixel)
Save as PNG
with
.meow
extension
Result
: Perfect PNG that works everywhere + hidden AI data
Storage Specifications
Magic Header
:
MEOW_STEG_V2
(12 bytes)
Capacity
: 6 bits per pixel (RGB channels o

data.title: An origin trial for a new HTML <permission> element (2024)
data.author: tentacleuno
data.article_summary:
Chrome的权限团队正在试验一种新的HTML <permission> 元素，作为声明式请求权限的方法，以解决命令式请求权限带来的问题。目前，网页应用通过命令式方法请求权限，例如使用Geolocation API请求用户位置，或通过Notification.requestPermission()请求通知权限。然而，这种方式会导致“权限垃圾信息”问题，即网站在用户未交互时就弹出权限提示，影响用户体验。

浏览器通过要求用户手势（如点击）来缓解此问题，但这并不总是有效。此外，权限提示常显示在不易察觉的位置，且用户一旦拒绝权限，重新启用较为困难。

新的<permission>元素旨在通过声明式方法简化权限请求流程，目前正在Chrome 126中进行初步试验，目标是实现标准化。这将帮助开发者更好地管理权限请求，提升用户体验。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Google提出的<permission>元素及其在浏览器中的实现和标准化问题

不同观点：
• **支持观点**：有人认为该提议解决了网站通过虚假提示获取权限的问题，并将权限提示移到页面内容中，由浏览器控制，减少了网站对用户的干扰。这被认为是一种更好的模型，有助于避免网站滥用权限提示。
• **反对观点**：一些人认为该提议绕过了标准流程，可能带来新的问题，例如点击劫持攻击。还有人担心这会改变权限提示的方式，使提示成为用户体验设计的一部分，而非浏览器控制，这可能导致用户在视觉上受到误导。
• **对Google动机的质疑**：有评论质疑Google推动此提案的动机，认为Google可能从中获得商业利益，例如通过减少广告屏蔽能力来保护其广告业务。还有人担心该提案可能使用户更难明确地拒绝权限。

补充讨论：
• **技术实现问题**：有评论指出该元素在技术实现上的难点，例如如何防止点击劫持攻击，以及在元素上叠加其他元素可能导致的漏洞。还有人担心浏览器团队将面临大量的维护问题。
• **用户体验问题**：一些评论认为该元素的样式限制过于复杂，可能会导致用户难以区分真假权限提示。同时，有人提出了一种替代方案，即通过一种不可完全自定义但可视化的元素来显示权限信息，以提高用户理解和安全性。
• **争议焦点**：提案中的权限提示方式及其对用户的安全性和易用性影响是争议的主要焦点。特别是如何在提供便利的同时，避免用户被误导或被迫授予过多权限。

通过这些讨论，可以看出各方对于新提案的潜在影响存在不同看法，主要围绕安全、用户体验和商业动机展开。

Homepage
There are a number of
imperative
methods for asking for permission to use
powerful features like location access in web apps. These methods come with a
number of challenges, which is why the Chrome permissions team is experimenting
with a new
declarative
method: a dedicated HTML
<permission>
element. This
element is in origin trial from Chrome 126, and ultimately we hope to
standardize it.
Imperative methods for requesting permission
When web apps need access to
powerful features
, they
need to ask for permission. For example, when
Google Maps
requires the user's location using the
Geolocation API
,
browsers will prompt the user, often with the option to store that decision.
This is a
well defined concept
in the Permissions specification.
Implicitly ask on first use versus explicitly request upfront
The Geolocation API is a powerful API and relies on the implicitly ask on first
use approach. For example, when an app calls the
navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition()
method, the permissions prompt automatically pops up upon the first call.
Another example is
navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia()
.
Other APIs, like the
Notification API
or
the
Device Orientation and Motion API
,
commonly have an explicit way to request permission through a static method like
Notification.requestPermission()
or
DeviceMotionEvent.requestPermission()
.
Note:
Historically, there were plans for yet another way to get permission,
namely an explicit
navigator.permissions.request()
method, but it was removed
from the Permissions API following the discussion in
Issue #83
in the specification's
repository. The question of the "right" approach between these methods
(implicitly prompt upon use and explicitly request permission) is a much
discussed topic without a clear answer.
Challenges with imperative methods for asking for permission
Permission spam
In the past, websites could call methods like
navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia()
or
Notification.requestPermission()
,
but also
navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition()
immediately when a website
was loaded. A permission prompt would pop up before the user had interacted with
the website. This is sometimes described as permission spam and affects both
approaches, implicitly asking on first use as well as explicitly requesting
upfront.
Browser mitigations and user gesture requirement
Permission spam led to browser vendors requiring a user gesture like a button
click or a keydown event before showing a permission prompt. The problem with
this approach is that it's very difficult, if not impossible, for the browser to
figure out if a given user gesture should result in a permission prompt to be
shown or not. Maybe the user was just clicking on the page in frustration
anywhere because the page took so long to load, or maybe they were indeed
clicking on the
Locate me
button. Some websites also became very good at
tricking users into clicking on content to trigger the prompt.
Another mitigation is adding prompt abuse mitigations, like completely blocking
features to begin with, or to showing the permission prompt in a non-modal, less
intrusive manner.
Permission contextualization
Another challenge, especially on big screens, is the way the permission prompt
gets commonly displayed: above the
line of death
, that
is, outside of the area of the browser window that the app can draw onto. It's
not unheard of that users would miss the prompt at the top of their browser
window when they just clicked a button at the bottom of the window. This problem
is often exacerbated when browser spam mitigations are in place.
No easy undo
Finally, it is too easy for users to navigate themselves into a dead-end. For
example, once the user has blocked access to a feature, it requires them to be
aware of the site information drop-down where they can either
Reset
permissions
or toggle blocked permissions back on. Both options in the worst
case require a full reload of the page until the updated setting takes effect.
Sites have no ability to provide an easy shortcut for users to change an
existing permission state and have to painstakingly explain to users how to
change their settings as shown at the bottom of the following Google Maps
screenshot.
If the permission is key to the experience, for example, microphone access for a
video conferencing application, apps like Google Meet show intrusive dialogs
that instruct the user how to unblock the permission.
A declarative
<permission>
element
To address the challenges described in this post, the Chrome permissions team
have launched an origin trial for a new HTML element,
<permission>
. This
element lets developers declaratively ask for permission to use, for now, a
subset of the powerful features available to websites. In its simplest form
44281633.article_summary:
Chrome的权限团队正在试验一种新的HTML <permission> 元素，作为声明式请求权限的方法，以解决命令式请求权限带来的问题。目前，网页应用通过命令式方法请求权限，例如使用Geolocation API请求用户位置，或通过Notification.requestPermission()请求通知权限。然而，这种方式会导致“权限垃圾信息”问题，即网站在用户未交互时就弹出权限提示，影响用户体验。

浏览器通过要求用户手势（如点击）来缓解此问题，但这并不总是有效。此外，权限提示常显示在不易察觉的位置，且用户一旦拒绝权限，重新启用较为困难。

新的<permission>元素旨在通过声明式方法简化权限请求流程，目前正在Chrome 126中进行初步试验，目标是实现标准化。这将帮助开发者更好地管理权限请求，提升用户体验。

data.title: Tiny-diffusion: A minimal implementation of probabilistic diffusion models
data.author: BraverHeart
data.article_summary: "tiny-diffusion" 是一个最小化的 PyTorch 实现，用于 2D 数据集的概率扩散模型。项目包含对扩散模型前向和反向过程的实现，并通过一系列消融实验探讨了学习率、模型大小、时间步长、方差调度等超参数对模型性能的影响。实验表明，学习率对模型训练效果显著，过短的时间步长会导致生成结果不完整，而不同的方差调度方式也有不同影响。此外，模型的隐藏层大小和层数并不是性能的瓶颈，时间步信息对模型有帮助，但具体编码方式不重要。输入的正弦嵌入有助于学习高频函数。项目使用了 Datasaurus Dozen 数据集，并参考了多个开源实现。
